# aos7-mailtodo

唯讀掃描各 mailbox 的 `inbox/*.md` 與 `inbox/done/*.md`，輸出一行 JSON；不修復或修改 node。

## 第一次跑

```sh
python3 packs/mailtodo/bin/aos7-mailtodo <folder> --now 2026-10-09T19:00:00+08:00
```

`--now` 必須是帶時區的 ISO 時間；資料中未帶時區的 `at` 採用該時區。輸入不是目錄或時間無效時，退出碼為 2，stdout 為空。

在 repo 根目錄執行測試與獨立核對：

```sh
python3 proto7-2/tests/run_all.py packs/mailtodo/tests
python3 check_answer.py proto7-2 fixture
```

"""Behavioral tests for the read-only mailtodo command."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


ENTRY = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "bin" / "aos7-mailtodo"
NOW = "2026-10-09T19:00:00+08:00"


class MailtodoTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name) / "node"
        self.root.mkdir()

    def letter(self, box, name, where="inbox", **changes):
        directory = self.root / box / "inbox"
        if where == "done":
            directory /= "done"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fields = {"id": name, "from": "alice", "to": "bob",
                  "status": "REQUEST", "at": "2026-10-09T18:00:30"}
        fields.update(changes)
        path = directory / name
        path.write_text("---\n" + "".join(
            "%s: %s\n" % (key, value) for key, value in fields.items()
        ) + "---\n", encoding="utf-8")
        return path

    def command(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ENTRY), *map(str, args)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def summary(self):
        result = self.command(self.root, "--now", NOW)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.count("\n"), 1)
        value = json.loads(result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(set(value), {"v", "open", "boxes", "bad"})
        self.assertIs(type(value["v"]), int)
        return value

    def test_open_resolution_counts_and_negative_floor(self):
        self.letter("alice", "20261009T1829-one.md", id="one", to="z")
        self.letter("alice", "20261009T1829-two.md", id="two",
                    at="2026-10-09T19:00:01+08:00", to="a")
        self.letter("alice", "20261009T1829-three.md", id="three")
        self.letter("bob", "20261009T1830-progress.md", id="progress",
                    status="PROGRESS", re="one")
        self.letter("bob", "20261009T1831-done.md", where="done",
                    id="answer", status="DONE", re="three")
        (self.root / "empty" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
        value = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(value["open"], [
            {"id": "two", "from": "alice", "to": "a", "where": "inbox", "age_min": -1},
            {"id": "one", "from": "alice", "to": "z", "where": "inbox", "age_min": 59}])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"], {
            "alice": {"inbox": {"REQUEST": 3}, "done": 0},
            "bob": {"inbox": {"PROGRESS": 1}, "done": 1},
            "empty": {"inbox": {}, "done": 0}})
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [])

    def test_bad_priority_duplicates_and_empty_re(self):
        absent = self.root / "a" / "inbox" / "20261009T1829-absent.md"
        absent.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        absent.write_text("not frontmatter\n", encoding="utf-8")
        missing = self.letter("a", "wrong.md", id="")
        invalid_name = self.letter("a", "20261309T1829-invalid.md", id="dup")
        first = self.letter("a", "20261009T1829-first.md", id="dup", re="")
        duplicate = self.letter("b", "20261009T1830-second.md", id="dup")
        value = self.summary()
        self.assertEqual(value["bad"], [
            {"file": path.relative_to(self.root).as_posix(), "why": why}
            for path, why in sorted([(absent, "no_frontmatter"), (missing, "no_field"),
                                     (invalid_name, "bad_name"), (duplicate, "dup_id")])])
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"]["a"]["inbox"], {"REQUEST": 1})
        self.assertEqual(value["boxes"]["b"]["inbox"], {})
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in value["open"]], ["dup"])
        self.assertEqual(first.read_text(encoding="utf-8").count("re: \n"), 1)

    def test_duplicate_keys_and_ignored_paths(self):
        path = self.letter("a", "20261009T1829-letter.md", id="old")
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        path.write_text(text.replace("id: old\n", "id: old\nid: last\n"), encoding="utf-8")
        (path.parent / ".hidden.md").write_text("bad", encoding="utf-8")
        (path.parent / "nested").mkdir()
        (path.parent / "nested" / "20261009T1829-nested.md").write_text("bad", encoding="utf-8")
        (self.root / ".private" / "inbox").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root / ".private" / "inbox" / "20261009T1829-private.md").write_text("bad")
        self.assertEqual([item["id"] for item in self.summary()["open"]], ["last"])
        self.assertEqual(self.summary()["bad"], [])

    def test_bad_arguments_leave_stdout_empty(self):
        file_path = self.root / "not-a-folder"
        file_path.write_text("x")
        for arguments in ((self.root,), (self.root, "--now", "invalid"),
                          (self.root, "--now", "2026-10-09T19:00:00"),
                          (file_path, "--now", NOW),
                          (self.root / "missing", "--now", NOW)):
            with self.subTest(arguments=arguments):
                result = self.command(*arguments)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")

    def test_read_only_with_nonwritable_input(self):
        path = self.letter("a", "20261009T1829-readonly.md")
        path.chmod(0o444)
        inbox = path.parent
        inbox.chmod(0o555)
        try:
            def snapshot():
                return {p.relative_to(self.root).as_posix():
                        (p.stat().st_mode, p.stat().st_size, p.stat().st_mtime_ns,
                         p.read_bytes() if p.is_file() else None)
                        for p in (self.root, *self.root.rglob("*"))}
            before = snapshot()
            self.assertEqual(len(self.summary()["open"]), 1)
            self.assertEqual(snapshot(), before)
        finally:
            inbox.chmod(0o755)
            path.chmod(0o644)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
